title: New in Symfony 8.2: New Mailer and Notifier Bridges
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony provides more than 100 ready-to-use bridges to send emails and
notifications through third-party services. From major platforms like Google,
Microsoft, and Amazon to smaller regional providers, they let you switch
services by changing a DSN.
